caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object, predominantly colored in shades of olive green and yellowish-green, with areas suggesting reflective highlights. The object has a broad, circular base that transitions into a tall, narrow cylindrical stem. At the top of the stem, there is a rounded, lidded container or chamber with a central seam, topped by a conical and then cylindrical section that narrows to a vertical extension at the very top. There is a small, horizontal rod protruding from the upper chamber with a disc-shaped feature at its end. The object is placed within a rectangular lined border on an off-white, slightly yellowed background.
title: Lamp
